name: blitzspirit-standalone
description: BlitzSpirit ISSUE_001 storefront - standalone Astro build, no Shopify.

scripts.prebuild: npm run validate && npm run check
scripts.build: astro build && astro build --config astro.neo.config.mjs && node tools/neo-merge.mjs && astro build --config astro.skeuo.config.mjs && node tools/skeuo-merge.mjs && astro build --config astro.pub.config.mjs && node tools/pub-merge.mjs
scripts.postbuild: node tools/check-build.mjs && node tools/check-build.mjs dist/neomorphism /neomorphism && node tools/check-build.mjs dist/skeuomorphism /skeuomorphism && node tools/check-build.mjs dist/pub /pub
